Gosh Authenticator for Linux - Installation Instructions
========================================================

Version: 1.0.0
Platform: Linux x86_64

DISTRIBUTION FORMATS
--------------------

1. RPM Package (gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-1.fc43.x86_64.rpm)
   - For Fedora, RHEL, Rocky Linux, AlmaLinux, openSUSE
   - Includes automatic desktop integration
   - Recommended for system-wide installation

2. Tarball (gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-linux-x64.tar.gz)
   - Portable bundle for any Linux distribution
   - No package manager required
   - Can run from any location

INSTALLATION METHODS
--------------------

### Option 1: RPM Package (Recommended for Fedora/RHEL-based systems)

Install with dnf:
  sudo dnf install ./gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-1.fc43.x86_64.rpm

Or with rpm:
  sudo rpm -ivh gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-1.fc43.x86_64.rpm

The package will:
- Install binary to /usr/bin/gosh-authenticator
- Install desktop file to /usr/share/applications/
- Install icon to /usr/share/icons/hicolor/
- Automatically update desktop database and icon cache

To uninstall:
  sudo dnf remove gosh-authenticator


### Option 2: Tarball (For any Linux distribution)

Extract the tarball:
  tar -xzf gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-linux-x64.tar.gz
  cd gosh-authenticator-1.0.0-linux-x64

Run directly:
  ./gosh_yubikey_manager

For desktop integration (optional):
  # Copy desktop file
  mkdir -p ~/.local/share/applications
  cp com.github.gosh.gosh_yubikey_manager.desktop ~/.local/share/applications/
  
  # Update Exec path in desktop file to point to your installation
  sed -i "s|Exec=gosh_yubikey_manager|Exec=$PWD/gosh_yubikey_manager|" \
    ~/.local/share/applications/com.github.gosh.gosh_yubikey_manager.desktop
  
  # Copy icon
  mkdir -p ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps
  cp icon.svg ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor/scalable/apps/com.github.gosh.gosh_yubikey_manager.svg
  
  # Update databases
  update-desktop-database ~/.local/share/applications
  gtk-update-icon-cache ~/.local/share/icons/hicolor

REQUIREMENTS
------------

Runtime dependencies:
- pcscd (PC/SC Smart Card Daemon)
- GTK 3
- Standard system libraries (glibc, etc.)

To install pcscd:
  Fedora/RHEL: sudo dnf install pcsc-lite
  Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install pcscd
  Arch: sudo pacman -S pcsclite

Enable and start pcscd:
  sudo systemctl enable --now pcscd

USAGE
-----

1. Insert your YubiKey
2. Launch "Gosh Yubikey Manager" from your application menu
   or run: gosh-authenticator (RPM) or ./gosh_yubikey_manager (tarball)
3. Manage your OATH credentials

TROUBLESHOOTING
---------------

If the icon doesn't appear correctly in the taskbar on KDE Plasma Wayland:
- Log out and log back in to refresh the desktop cache
- Ensure the desktop file is properly installed

For more information, see README.md
